metadata.title: Cattle-manure biogas screening benchmarks
metadata.warning: Potential/yield benchmarks are not Botswana measured digester performance. Collectable manure depends strongly on feeding system; year-round grazing manure should not be assumed collectable.

collection_rule.note: GridIQ does not infer a collectable fraction for grazing cattle. A collection fraction or directly measured collectable manure mass is required before energy potential is calculated.
